nuclide_numbers.says: Astatine-211 has mass number 211 and atomic number 85; element 120 has atomic number 120; uranium-238 is 238 and 92, radium-226 226 and 88 (read off the names and the periodic table).

particles.says: A helium-4 nucleus has mass number 4 and atomic number 2; a proton has mass number 1 and atomic number 1.

thorium_234.says: Thorium-234 is the nucleus with mass number 234 and atomic number 90.

radon_222.says: Radon-222 is the nucleus with mass number 222 and atomic number 86.

conservation.says: A decay that emits one particle conserves mass number and charge: the product's numbers are the parent's minus the emitted particle's.
conservation.z3: All(n, [at211, e120, u238, ra226], And(mass_number(decays_into(n)) + mass_number(emits(n)) == mass_number(n), atomic_number(decays_into(n)) + atomic_number(emits(n)) == atomic_number(n)))

at211_alpha.says: The decay of astatine-211 in question is an alpha decay.

e120_alpha.says: The decay of the element-120 nuclide is an alpha decay.
